description: Land Acquisition - Aluthgama, Beruwala D/S Division, Kalutara District and Iddamalgoda, Eheliyagoda D/S Division, Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land extent, location, boundaries, and survey information. The content focuses exclusively on land matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
